summary.text: Kenneth Brennan is the Republican candidate for the New Mexico House of Representatives, District 50, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired Navy chief petty officer and former mayor of Edgewood, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his top priority is retaining and attracting health care professionals to New Mexico.

paragraphs.text: Kenneth Brennan was born in Norwood, Massachusetts, graduated from Cibola High School and served in the U.S. Navy from 1980 to 2000.
He attended the University of Phoenix, and his career has included work as a manager and gas turbine electrician.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he retired from the Navy as a Chief Petty Officer and then spent 23 years in the power-generation and renewable-energy industries, including 17 years in management, before retiring from the private sector in 2023.
Brennan said he has served more than four years on the Edgewood Town Commission, including 28 months as appointed mayor.

He said he currently serves on the North Central Regional Transportation District board and executive committee, chairs the Mid-Region Regional Transportation Office board, and sits on the boards of Workforce Connections of Central New Mexico, the Mid-Region Council of Governments and the New Mexico Municipal League.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.

Brennan said his top legislative priority is retaining and attracting physicians, nurses and other medical professionals, and that he supports improved access to 24/7 emergency and urgent care in rural communities.
He also said New Mexico must improve its education system and better connect education with workforce needs.
